categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Tiantan Biological Products Corporation Limited primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of blood products. Its main product categories include human albumin, human immunoglobulin (including pH4 formulations), tetanus immunoglobulin, hepatitis B immunoglobulin, and recombinant coagulation factors. The company operates through several subsidiaries specializing in blood product manufacturing and plasma collection.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes plasma protein separation technologies such as low-temperature ethanol fractionation and virus inactivation processes to ensure product safety. It also employs gene recombination technology for developing recombinant coagulation factors. Production is supported by advanced manufacturing execution systems (MES), SCADA, warehouse management systems (WMS), and smart quality control systems to enhance automation, quality, and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are hospitals, medical institutions, and retail pharmacies across China, with over 700 tertiary hospitals covered nationwide. The company also exports products to international markets including Macau. Key therapeutic areas served include pediatrics, neurology, hematology, and critical care.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with plasma collection stations in 16 provinces and autonomous regions, totaling 107 stations (85 operational). It has production bases in Chengdu, Kunming, Lanzhou, Shanghai, Wuhan, Guizhou, and Xi'an. Internationally, it has begun market development and product registration in regions such as Macau.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tiantan Bio operates primarily midstream and downstream in the blood products supply chain, controlling plasma collection (upstream raw material sourcing) through its own plasma stations, manufacturing blood products, and distributing finished products to medical institutions and pharmacies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in blood product and recombinant protein development, focusing on clinical needs and lifecycle quality management. Key R&D projects include recombinant coagulation factors VIIa, VIII, IX, and subcutaneous immunoglobulin. It invests heavily in digital transformation, smart manufacturing, and expanding plasma collection capacity to enhance product yield and quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of blood products and recombinant biologics. Sales are conducted via designated distributors to hospitals and retail pharmacies, supported by government procurement tenders. The company also earns investment income and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tiantan Bio is a leading domestic player in China's blood products industry, competing with companies like Taibang Bio, Shanghai RAAS, Hualan Bio, and others. It holds a significant market share with a broad product portfolio and strong brand recognition. The industry is characterized by high entry barriers, strict regulation, and concentration among a few large players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 6.03 billion, a 16.44% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.55 billion, up 39.58%. Total assets reached RMB 15.87 billion with net assets of RMB 11.14 billion, reflecting steady growth and strong profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tiantan Bio emphasizes product quality, safety, and comprehensive lifecycle management, supported by advanced manufacturing and quality control systems. Its extensive plasma collection network ensures stable raw material supply. The company differentiates through a broad and innovative product pipeline, including recombinant products, and a strong brand portfolio recognized nationally. It also leverages digitalization and smart manufacturing to enhance operational efficiency and product consistency.
